[Verse 1]
[C]
[Am]Virgil Caine
[C/G]is the name and I served
[F]on the [Am/E]Danville train
[Dm]
[Am]'Til Stoneman's
[C/G]cavalry came and
[F]tore up the [Am/E]tracks again
[Dm]
[Am/E]In the winter of
[F]sixty five, we were
[C]hungry, just
[Dm]barely alive
[Am/E]By May the tenth,
[F]Richmond had fell It's a time
[C]I re-
[Dm]member, oh so well
[D]The

[Chorus]
[C/G]night they drove
[Fmaj7]old Dixie down
[C/G]And the bells
[Fmaj7]were ringing The
[C/G]night they drove
[Fmaj7]old Dixie down
[C/G]And the peo-
[Fmaj7]ple were singing They went,
[C/G]"La, la, la"
[Am]"La, la, la"
[Gsus4]"La, la, la, la, la, la
[F]la, la, la"
[C]

[Verse 2]
[Am]Back with my wife in Ten-
[C/G]nessee When
[F]one day she [Am/E]called to me
[Dm]
[Am]"Virgil, quick,
[C/G]come see,
[F]there goes [Am/E]Robert E. Lee"
[Dm]Now
[Am/E]I don't mind chop-
[F]pin' wood And I
[C]don't care if the
[Dm]money's no good Ya
[Am/E]take what ya need and ya
[F]leave the rest But they should
[C]never have
[Dm]taken the very best
[D]The

[Chorus]
[C/G]night they drove
[Fmaj7]old Dixie down
[C/G]And the bells
[Fmaj7]were ringing The
[C/G]night they drove
[Fmaj7]old Dixie down
[C/G]And all the
[Fmaj7]people were singing They went,
[C/G]"La, la, la"
[Am]"La, la, la"
[Gsus4]"La, la, la, la, la, la
[F]la, la, la"
[C]
[F]
[C]

[Verse 3]
[Am]Like my father before
[C/G]me,
[F]I will work [Am/E]the land
[Dm]
[Am]And like my brother a-
[C/G]bove me,
[F]who took a [Am/E]rebel stand
[Dm]He was
[Am/E]just eighteen, proud
[F]and brave But a
[C]Yankee laid him
[Dm]in his grave I
[Am/E]swear by the mud below
[F]my feet You can't
[C]raise a Caine back up
[Dm]when he's in defeat
[D]The

[Chorus]
[C/G]night they drove
[Fmaj7]old Dixie down
[C/G]And the bells
[Fmaj7]were ringing The
[C/G]night they drove
[Fmaj7]old Dixie down
[C/G]And all the
[Fmaj7]people were singing They
[C/G]went, "La, la, la"
[Am]"La, la, la"
[Gsus4]"La, la, la, la, la, la
[F]la, la, la"
[C]
